'''Berowyn al'Vere''' is the daughter of [[Brandelwyn al'Vere|Bran]] and [[Marin al'Vere]]. She is the eldest sister of [[Egwene al'Vere]], as well as [[Alene al'Vere|Alene]], [[Elisa al'Vere|Elisa]] and [[Loise al'Vere]]. 

She was considered the prettiest of the al'Vere girls. 

==Abilities==
In "The Wheel of Time Companion" it is hinted that the mother and all the sisters of Egwene can learn to channel.

==History==
She braided her hair at sixteen. According to Egwene, she has a tendency to treat her "like a baby." 

Berowyn married in the year {{ne|989}} a man of the Lewin family, and had a daughter. However, her husband and daughter both died of [[Breakbone fever]] in {{ne|990}}. 

Berowyn could not run her farm alone, so she sold it to her in-law and returned to the al'Vere home also because she never got on with her husband's mother.

Berowyn later married again with an outlander, one of the refugees who entered the Two Rivers recently.
